goal: Implement W5-B2 rope voting and death/extract currency rules. Code location: `scripts/run/run_state.gd` (vote state), `scripts/autoload/game_state.gd` (request_extract_vote logic), `scripts/run/` (any new vote tally or currency rules). Acceptance: (1) Unit test `tests/unit/test_vote.gd` passes: unanimous living, downed excluded, `no` cancels, solo immediate; (2) Unit test `tests/unit/test_death_rules.gd` passes: every currency (gold, ore, echo, class_xp, story/codex/achievements) behaves per the SPEC-run-economy table for both extract and death (with relics lost on extract, kept on death per the design doc); (3) Headless two-instance smoke step 3 still green (rope mechanics do not break existing hostile tests). Command to verify: `godot --headless --path . -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gtest=test_vote.gd -gtest=test_death_rules.gd -gexit` (exit 0) and `tools/smoke_two.sh` (no new FAIL). Constraints: no UI (the vote prompt is week 5 scope); no save schema changes (use existing fields); vote is host-owned and broadcast by GameState; do not touch Rope.interact or NetworkManager.request_vote_rope (they are transport only). Must not change test counts on other tests.
